item.title: Legionella bacteria detected at Oakland County's Children’s Village, officials take action
item.description: Oakland County is taking action to prevent future problems at Children’s Village after routine testing detected low levels of Legionella bacteria at two buildings.

item.title: Brett White II: Oakland's 28-year-old guard proves it's never too late to chase your dreams
item.description: Brett White II is not your typical college basketball player. At 28 years old, the Oakland University guard is helping the Golden Grizzlies make a push in the Horizon League Tournament.

item.title: Second suspect arrested in February stabbing at Oakland University, police say
item.description: A second suspect has been arrested in connection with a stabbing that happened at Oakland University last month.
